$comment: Hand off a feature, 1: the review loop a PM and a coder run in a task's thread.
do: caption:A pair on one task|A PM agent holds the task. A coder does the work.
click:text="Add a gift message to orders"

eval:(() => { const c = document.querySelector('[data-testid="thread-conversation"]'); if (!c) return; let n = c; while (n && !/(auto|scroll)/.test(getComputedStyle(n).overflowY)) n = n.parentElement; if (!n) return; const go = () => n.scrollTo({ top: n.scrollHeight, behavior: 'smooth' }); go(); new MutationObserver(go).observe(c, { childList: true, subtree: true }); })()
caption:The PM writes what done means, first|Checks anyone could verify, before any code.
caption:The coder reports, with evidence|The branch, the test run, what changed.
caption:The PM checks it against the list|and sends it back with exactly what's missing.
wait-text:Added a test for the API response
caption:The coder fixes what was asked
caption:Every review is in the thread|Catching up is reading one thread.
